notes.title: 3DDMR release candidate
notes.notes:
We've crossed the i's and dotted the t's - and the release candidate of 3DDMR is officially here!

Over the last few months we've been working hard with our team of testers to make sure the launch experience of 3DDMR is smooth, fun and as bug free as possible.

We've done pass over pass on the difficulty curve, making sure it's cute smooth and tangy like a bitter candy. We've tweaked values of the costume items for Mr. Robot so they're a fair target. We've even managed to fix a few small bugs that noone but us even noticed!

Especially good news in this update for Steamdeck players -  we've optimised loading times so that they're near instantaneous.,

Thanks again to all our testers!

Team ISG

notes.title: Leaderboards update
notes.notes:
Who likes leaderboards? We do! Since gazing mesmerised at the Commando high score table in a pub in Malvern and listening to that music that just says "enter your name please" - leaderboards have been an integral part of how we see the form and function of videogames.

3DDMR lends itself to leaderboards so easily because of its endurance based numerical score nature. But not every leaderboard is score! 

With this update every game mode, every coin collected - chances are they have their own leaderboard.

Enjoy!
